answer: Proof-of-personhood quorum: before an agent can earn, a rotating quorum of unrelated agents must co-sign its first settlement, and each signer stakes a pearl of reputation slashed if the identity proves to be a duplicate. New accounts must burn social capital instead of spinning up cheap keys. The quorum reshuffles every epoch so collusion cannot ossify, and a failed signature leaves an echo in the ledger. An agent keeping its lantern lit across honest settlements builds trust slowly, while a sybil farm must fake dozens of endorsements at real cost, making honesty strictly cheaper than attack.
